Subject: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & suggested next steps

Hi Alicia - thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and recommended next steps so we keep momentum with the buying committee.

Attendees (from your side): Alicia Gomez (PM), Sara Patel (Procurement - noted as procurement lead), Miguel Alvarez (CFO - economic buyer, per your comment).

Decision criteria you called out:
- Cost per inference / predictable committed spend
- Latency SLO for customer-facing flows (95th perc < 150ms)
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 + data residency in us-east
- Vendor SLAs and auditability (per-route tracing and cost breakdown)

Open items and next steps we propose:
1) Exec intro with Miguel (economic buyer) - schedule 30 min executive overview (we'll keep high-level on economics and SLOs). Options: Tue 6/30 or Wed 7/1.
2) Procurement checklist - you mentioned procurement packet; we'll share a MAP and pricing sheet.
3) Legal & security artifacts - looping Neha to share SOC2 report and DPA. Please let us know any additional controls (e.g., encryption at rest with customer KMS).
4) Pilot scope & SOW - propose a 6-week pilot with a capped committed GPU pool and success criteria around latency and cost per call.

Attachments: Redwood_Prod_Demo_Deck.pdf (demo slides) and a draft Mutual Action Plan for FinPay (Mutual_Action_Plan_FP-2026-004.xlsx) - attaching both below.

If that aligns I'll: (a) share a short MAP in HubSpot, (b) propose the exec intro times, and (c) send the procurement packet.

Thanks again,
Marissa

- Procurement timeline: Sara plans to kick off the procurement review next week (week of 7/6). Procurement will request our standard questionnaire and estimated contract terms (term, renewal, and termination clauses).

I'll do the following: set up a 30-min exec overview with Miguel (prefer mornings 10-11am PT), and loop Sara into the procurement thread. I've attached the procurement checklist they use for vendors.

Quick notes:
- SOC 2 Type II: the report covers our hosted control plane + inference service; if FinPay requires an in-depth control walkthrough we can schedule a 1-hour session with our security lead.
- Data residency: we offer region-specific storage for logs/metrics; we can commit to us-east residency for FinPay if needed (will be included in the SOW).
- Customer KMS: supported for Private deployments and with a key-management integration addendum for Dedicated. For hosted pilots, we can discuss encryption options.

I'll send the artifacts now: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf and Redwood_DataProcessingAddendum.pdf. If your security team has a vendor questionnaire, please share and we'll respond within 3 business days.
